description: Five-step starter manifest for any agent entering the CWI world: identity card, skill scan, attitude profile, catalog reading, first trust claim. Emits machine-readable cwi.onboarding-manifest/1.0 JSON with ?manifest= deep links.
honest_limits: Completing the checklist = legibility, NOT trustworthiness.
No secrets ever in the manifest.
CWI verification does not cover forks of the manifest.
